content.short: Forest Staking runs enterprise validator infrastructure across Monad, Aptos, Sui and other networks.
content.description: Forest Staking operates validators for proof-of-stake networks including Monad, handling the uptime and key management that delegators would otherwise take on themselves. Validator quality is largely invisible until something goes wrong, at which point missed blocks or a slashing event make the operator's engineering very visible.
